prompt.en: How many of the Acadians were deported from their homeland between 1755 and 1763?
prompt.fr: Quelle proportion des Acadiens a été déportée de sa terre natale entre 1755 et 1763?

options.fr: Plus des deux tiers d'entre eux.

explanation.en: More than two-thirds of the Acadians were deported during the war between Britain and France. Enough remained, and enough returned, for Acadian culture to survive and flourish today.
explanation.fr: Plus des deux tiers des Acadiens ont été déportés pendant la guerre entre la Grande-Bretagne et la France. Il en est resté, et il en est revenu, assez pour que la culture acadienne survive et s'épanouisse aujourd'hui.

source.quote: Between 1755 and 1763, during the war between Britain and France, more than two-thirds of the Acadians were deported from their homeland.
